career_ladder.note: The Nagaland Civil Service (NCS) is the premier state administrative service of Nagaland administered by the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (DP&AR). Recruits enter as Extra Assistant Commissioners (EAC, Class-I Gazetted, Junior Grade) and advance through SDO (Civil), Deputy Secretary / Additional Deputy Commissioner (ADC), Joint Secretary / ADC (Senior Selection Grade), Additional Secretary / DC / Director, and Special Secretary / Commissioner & Secretary, with statutory avenues for induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) Nagaland Cadre under the IAS (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations.

exam_scheme.note: The Nagaland Combined Civil Services Examination (NCS, NPS & Allied Services) is conducted annually under the NPSC (Conduct of Examination) Rules and the revised syllabus notified on 23 June 2026. The examination follows a rigorous three-tier architecture: Preliminary Screening Test (200 marks, objective MCQ with 33% negative marking), Main Written Examination (1,200 marks across 6 conventional descriptive papers of 200 marks each, covering General Studies I to IV, General Studies Nagaland, and English Comprehension & Essay), and Personality Test / Viva-voce (70 marks). Merit ranking for final appointment is determined by aggregate marks in the Main Written Examination and Viva-voce (total 1,270 marks).

stages.source_label: NPSC Revised Examination Scheme and Syllabus Notification dated 23.06.2026

papers.negative_marking: 0.66 marks deducted per incorrect answer (33% negative marking penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening cut-off determined by Commission (approximately 10 times the number of advertised vacancies shortlisted for Main Examination under Rule 14(12))

stages.source_label: NPSC Revised Examination Scheme and Syllabus Notification dated 23.06.2026

papers.paper_name: Paper-I: General Studies-1 (Indian Heritage & Culture, History & Geography of World and Society)
Paper-II: General Studies-2 (Governance, Constitution, Polity, Social Justice, International Relations)
Paper-III: General Studies-3 (Technology, Economic Development, Biodiversity, Environment, Security, Disaster Management)
Paper-IV: General Studies-4 (Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude)
Paper-V: General Studies - Nagaland (History, Art & Culture, Geography, Economy, Polity & Governance, Society, Current Affairs of Nagaland)
Paper-VI: English Comprehension and Essay (Objective English Comprehension/Grammar + Two Descriptive Essays of 50 marks each)

stages.source_label: NPSC Conduct of Examination Rules 2008 (Rule 14(10) and Rule 18) & Revised Scheme Notification 2026

papers.qualifying_threshold: No minimum qualifying marks; candidates shortlisted at 3 times the vacancies under Rule 14(13); marks added to Main Written marks for final rank list

financial_package.note: Pay scales for administrative cadres recruited through NPSC CCE (such as Extra Assistant Commissioner - EAC, Deputy Superintendent of Police - DSP, Block Development Officer / RDO / APO, and District Commandant HG/CD) are fixed at Pay Level-13 under the Nagaland Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2017 (Notification No. FIN/ESTT-2/11/VII CPC/16 dated 16.12.2017). Entry basic pay is ₹56,100 with standard dearness allowance, house rent allowance, transport allowances, and medical reimbursement.
financial_package.pay_source_label: NPSC NCS, NPS & Allied Services Advertisement No. NPSC-2/NCS-2025 & Nagaland Finance Department ROP Rules 2017
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Nagaland ROP 2017 Pay Level-13 entry basic pay of ₹56,100 with benchmark 58% DA effective 1 July 2025 (DA = ₹32,538, confirmed via Nagaland Finance Dept OM FIN/ROP/4/84/(Vol-II)), House Rent Allowance (8% to 10% based on classification of posting town/district HQ, approx. ₹4,488 - ₹5,610), Medical Allowance (₹1,000), and Special Duty/Executive Allowances (approx. ₹1,500 - ₹6,750); estimated gross is ₹94,000 - ₹1,02,000. Net in-hand reflects statutory deductions including 10% National Pension System (NPS Tier-I contribution on Basic+DA = ₹8,864), Group Insurance Scheme (GIS, ₹400), and Nagaland Professional Tax (₹208/month), giving take-home range ₹84,000 - ₹92,000.
official_perks: Designated government executive bungalow / residential quarters in district or sub-divisional administrative headquarters
Official executive vehicle with dedicated driver and government fuel entitlement for administrative and law & order duties
Armed police security escort / pilot protection for field officers in executive postings (EAC, SDO(C), DSP)
Comprehensive medical reimbursement for self and dependent family members under Nagaland Medical Attendance Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual children education assistance as per Nagaland government service norms
